correctness.rationale: For all odd p and prime-power q, the quandle product is exactly alpha(u)beta(v) in the cyclic group algebra. For char≠p, Fourier inversion, support orbit closure, t^N conditions, exact Frobenius descent and gcd root counting prove 2(1+g)^(s/d); char never divides g. For char=p, augmentation-zero idempotents vanish by nilpotence of I, and truncated logarithm identifies augmentation-one solutions with the kernel of 1-alpha-beta, whose h-spaced eigencharacters number s. Standalone direct coefficient multiplication exhausts 17 specified finite-field instances (including p=17 q=2, nonprime fields q=4 and 9, and modular p=3,5,7); computations are supporting rather than universal proof.

value.rationale: An exact canonical invariant of an infinite family of nonassociative algebras, motivated by 2026 Fourier studies. It resolves every finite-field characteristic for all odd prime sizes and exhibits a sharp arithmetic and characteristic transition, e.g. E_17(2)=648 versus E_17(3)=36 versus E_17(17)=290. The modular eigenspace dimension and Frobenius orbit/root counts supply more information than prior R3 and integral rigidity cases; no application or downstream theorem is required for this natural complete enumeration.
